# Advisories govulncheck reports and the code does not suffer from. One ID per
# line, then the reason. Remove a line when its reason stops being true: the
# script warns about lines that no longer match anything.

# github.com/docker/docker is the Docker client library here. These two are
# bugs of the Docker daemon (AuthZ plugins, plugin privileges) that live in the
# same Go module, which the advisories flag as a whole ("introduced: 0"); no
# version of github.com/docker/docker fixes them, only the new module path
# github.com/moby/moby/v2 does (2.0.0-beta.8). Pitlane does not run a daemon
# or manage plugins. Move to moby/moby/v2 once its client is stable.
GO-2026-4883 daemon plugin privilege validation (moby)
GO-2026-4887 daemon AuthZ plugin bypass (moby)
